svg.text: Just-in-time roles only. SHA-256 of both files checked. Never reuse an init file from another environment.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Notify the tooling owner and have them confirm the endpoint reports.

svg.text: Method letters match the runbook's method table: C remote, D managed fleets, E Tanium-native. Controls: CM-8 (inventory), AC-6 (scoped, just-in-time roles; credential rights removed after the campaign).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.
